sources.name: Kingofshojo
sources.changes:
First draft.

- Catalog (browse + search) through /page/<n>/?s=<query>, titles from /manga/<slug>/,
  chapter pages from #readerarea img.

sources.name: MangaDex
sources.changes:
- Catalog (browse + search) through /manga, availableTranslatedLanguage[] set from the device's language.
- Titles with cover, description, authors, genres and status.
- Chapter lists through /chapter (language-filtered, ascending, first 100).
- Reader pages through /at-home/server/:id with let (baseUrl, hash).

sources.name: ToonSpace (toon.free)
sources.changes:
First draft.

- Catalog from the JSON explore API (/api/explore) with cursor pagination.
- Titles from /title/<slug>, chapter pages from /read/<slug>/chapter-<n>.
- No server-side search (the site searches client-side); video "shorts" items appear with an
  empty chapter list.
